patch.summary: Fastmail migration guide: inventory → rehearse → freeze → validate integrations — grounded in researched limitations and catalogue peers.

blocks.body: Migrate to Fastmail by inventorying legacy business-communications fields, mapping them to Fastmail objects, rehearsing a freeze window, and validating Dropbox, 1password before reopening writes.
bullets: Inventory → map → rehearse → cut over → reopen
Highest risk: Not a business phone, WhatsApp or team-chat product — adjacent to business communications
Success signal: shared inbox works for the pilot cohort

blocks.heading: Fastmail migration cutover playbook
blocks.body: Migrations fail from optimistic timelines — not from missing motivation.

scenarios.title: Field inventory
scenarios.body: Export legacy fields that power shared inbox and mark must-map vs archive.

scenarios.title: Rehearsal load
scenarios.body: Run a non-prod load into Fastmail; measure match rates before the freeze.

scenarios.title: Production freeze
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes; cut over; validate Dropbox; then reopen.

steps.label: Migrate when Small teams that want private, independent business email on their own domain outweigh migration cost
Delay if this limitation hits cutover: Not a business phone, WhatsApp or team-chat product — adjacent to business communications
If Fastmail mapping is poor, compare destination fit with SaneBox before moving data twice

items.title: No freeze window
items.body: Dual-writing without a freeze creates irrevocable duplicates.

items.title: Integrations last
items.body: Wire Dropbox in rehearsal — not on Monday morning after cutover.

items.title: Data risk 1
items.body: Not a business phone, WhatsApp or team-chat product — adjacent to business communications

items.title: Data risk 2
items.body: Shared addresses, shared calendars and the shared address book require Standard or above

items.title: Data risk 3
items.body: Basic is capped at 5 GB mail and 1 GB file storage

checklist.label: Complete field inventory for shared inbox
Mitigate: Not a business phone, WhatsApp or team-chat product — adjacent to business communications

notes: Migration: cutover risks, data mapping, checklist.
